# 7.2 DP on DAGs

Phase 7 (Integration), target rating 2000–2400. Bank status: short.

## Patterns

### Longest path in an acyclic graph (`longest-path`)

Longest path or best-scoring path by processing vertices in dependency order.

**Works because:** The graph has no directed cycle, so every vertex's best value depends only on earlier vertices in the order.

### Counting paths (`count-paths`)

Number of paths between two vertices of an acyclic graph, modulo a prime.

**Works because:** No directed cycles, so the number of paths is finite and accumulates in dependency order.

### Dynamic programming on components (`condensation-dp`)

Collapse strongly connected components first, then run the acyclic dynamic programming on the component graph.

**Works because:** Inside a component every vertex can reach every other, so a component acts as one vertex with combined value.

### Implicit acyclic state graphs (`state-dag`)

States with moves that always decrease some measure, processed in that order.

**Works because:** Some quantity strictly decreases along every move, so the state graph has no cycle.
